content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GGSGH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for GGSGH Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the GGSGH Senior Resident posts is scheduled for 07-09-2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post at GGSGH?
faq.answer: There are a total of 26 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident positions at Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital (GGSGH).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a P.G. Degree/Diploma/DNB or three years of experience in the concerned specialty from a recognized university/institution, along with valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident positions will receive a salary in Level-11, ranging from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month, plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GGSGH Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the GGSGH Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts at GGSGH involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Senior Resident positions at Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for GGSGH Senior Resident posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital (GGSGH) office in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).
